sources.title: PDF Seeing What You Say: Expressive Image Generation from Speech
sources.snippet: VoxStudio is the first end-to-end speech-to-image gen-eration model that totally leverages speech's expressive-ness to generate emotionally aligned images. VoxE-moset is a new benchmark, built cheaply, but complemen-tary with real-world datasets.
